scientific_integrity: The forest decomposition and generating-function proof give exact identities; a central limit theorem gives the constant. Exact rational coefficient and direct-history checks were executed. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The closed binomial sum and sharp exponential constant are obtained at copying parameter 1/3, while the all-parameter exact profile is implicit via formal power series.
The result concerns binary one-time marginals, not multi-time joint laws or growing-group cutoff.
Historical equivalent formulations of all-even percolation-component enumeration are a residual literature risk.
title: Exact binary step-reinforcement mixing profile and its sharp cubic specialization
